openClinicalQuestions: Which ovulation-confirmation tests should be described, and with what timing caveats?
How should PCOS-related false or repeated LH surges be phrased?
Which histories justify earlier fertility review in this clinic?

claimLedger.claim: Ovulation assessment can use menstrual history, urine LH testing and other clinical methods, each with limitations.
claimLedger.limitations: Patient education does not establish an individual fertile window.

claimLedger.claim: Irregular cycles can justify evaluation without relying only on a fixed duration of trying.
claimLedger.limitations: Exact timing depends on age and history and requires clinician review.
